message: Verdant 15.3.0 is now distributed through VCC/VPM. Add the Verdant Packages repository once, then use VCC > Manage Project to install and update Verdant World System.
notes: Added the Verdant Packages VCC/VPM community repository.
Published Verdant World System as package com.sorakaito.verdant.
VCC now manages the Verdant package version and future package updates.
Legacy managed script files use legacyFiles migration with preserved Unity GUIDs.
Scene-specific objects, manually placed props and world transforms remain outside the package.
VRCLinking, AudioLink and ProTV remain optional integrations rather than forced dependencies.
